headline: UK Government Explores Restrictions on Sales of Smart Glasses Over Privacy Concerns
summary: The UK government is considering restricting sales of smart glasses technology to specific user groups following concerns regarding surreptitious filming.
why: Potential sales bans or licensing rules on smart wearables create regulatory barriers for tech hardware manufacturers.

impacts.name: Consumer Electronics
impacts.why: Government restrictions on smart glass sales pose regulatory friction for wearable technology vendors.
